nodes.label: SessionStart sweep for unreported sessions
nodes.rationale: SessionEnd does not fire on terminal close/kill; spool only replays failed POSTs, so a bounded sweep plus idempotent ingest on externalId is the fix.

nodes.label: Key-shaped token redaction
nodes.rationale: Title falls back to the first prompt, which is routinely a pasted credential.

nodes.label: Extracted transcript (prompts, prose, tool names only)
nodes.norm_label: extracted transcript (prompts, prose, tool names only)
nodes.rationale: Attachments are 79.9% of bytes; keeping prompts/prose/tool names is 0.076% of raw and keeps env-bearing output off the wire. Redact before truncate; cap 1 MB gzipped, drop from front.

nodes.label: Active duration (gaps > 5 min dropped)
nodes.rationale: An overnight session measured 7,237 wall-clock minutes vs ~110 minutes of work.

nodes.label: Background update check
nodes.rationale: Third-party marketplaces don't auto-update by default; check at most twice a day, never self-updates.

nodes.label: OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628)
nodes.rationale: Nothing copied or pasted: a pasted key lands in clipboard, scrollback and the uploaded transcript; one real key was burned that way.

nodes.label: filesTouched counts only confirmed edits
nodes.rationale: Holding each edit until its tool_result confirms keeps denied/failed edits out; undercounting preferred over inventing files.

nodes.label: Incognito sessions
nodes.rationale: Session still recorded with usage/cost/model/duration only; conversation, title, repo, branch, files, PR withheld and server scrubs earlier reports; one-way per session.

nodes.label: prUrl must belong to the session repo
nodes.norm_label: prurl must belong to the session repo
nodes.rationale: A PR from an unrelated org in another tab once got reported as the session's own.

nodes.label: Pravex status line indicator
nodes.rationale: Plugins cannot declare statusLine, so the command writes ~/.claude/settings.json and chains any existing status line from a stable copy at ~/.pravex/statusline.js.

nodes.label: Zero-dependency (stdlib-only) assertion
nodes.rationale: Plugin runs inside someone else's Claude Code session so it must not pull anything at install time; node:-prefixed modules allowed by prefix because an explicit list went stale.
